Messages.Author: Brian
Messages.Body:
All the talk about allies, torpor and Burst of Sunlight got me
thinking, hey, Slave Gargoyle doesn't go to torpor from agg damage!

So, why not add the trait "vampire" to it? It would still be an ally,
recruited normally. It would still be burned by Kindred Segregation,
it would still have 0 bleed and all that; it's just that it would be
treated as a vampire, too...you could give it a skill card if you
wanted. It could go to/from torpor as usual.

I mean, it can "hunt" anyway...

Could it happen? Would anyone be opposed?

Just musing,
--Brian

Messages.Author: Brian
Messages.Body:
It's been a few days since I wrote the above...0 replies.

>sigh<

I'll try to show you how it's applicable. Assume Premise 1:

1. The Rules Team decides to add to Gargoyle Slave the trait
"Vampire".

Therefore,

2. A minion can be both "ally" and "vampire".

Therefore,

3. When a Rafastio Ghoul uses a Burst of Sunlight, it takes 1
aggravated damage (which is done to all vampires in combat).

and

4. When a Rafastio Ghoul takes 1 aggravated damage, it is treated the
same as regular damage (at least it is on Page 23 of the Jyhad
rulebook).

________________

This is all to say that, if a minion can be both Ally and Vampire,
which isn't too farfetched, then an ally who can play Burst of
Sunlight "as a vampire" would burn 1 life to heal the 1 aggravated
damage dealt to it. Still apalling that sunlight hurts it at all, but
hey, it would be SOMETHING.

I figure LSJ and the Rules Team will come up with something we can all
live with on this one, better than this suggestion...still, I'm
curious as to whether Gargoyle Slave could have added, or a future
ally will come printed with, the Vampire trait.

Is it possible, LSJ? Is it against the rules to be both?

--Brian

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Basically no and yeah, respectively.

Some effects are switch-logic effects that do one thing to an ally and
a different thing to a vampire.

If the ally doesn't go to torpor from agg, does the vampire burn when
empty? (That is, if the ally burns when empty, the vampire should go
to torpor from the agg).

A minion cannot be vampire and ally. Cannot be Sabbat and Camarilla.
Cannot be Brujah and Gangrel. Cannot be 8 capacity and 6 capacity.
Cannot be ready and in torpor. etc.
